format: html

## Introduction

This document explores NBA player game log data from the 2025-26 NBA season. The purpose of this exploration is to investigate player performance and identify useful numerical and graphical summaries that will later be incorporated into an interactive Shiny application.

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

nba <- read_parquet("data/nba_2025_26.parquet")

nba <- nba |>
  mutate(
    location = if_else(home, "Home", "Away")
  )
```

## Data Overview

```{r}
dim(nba)
names(nba)
glimpse(nba)
```

## Categorical Variable Summaries

### One-Way Contingency Table

The following table displays the number of player-game observations for each NBA team.

```{r}
team_table <- nba |>
  count(team) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

team_table
```

### Two-Way Contingency Table

The following table displays the number of player-game observations for each team separated by whether the game was played at home or away.

```{r}
team_location_table <- nba |>
  count(team, location) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = location,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

team_location_table
```

## Numerical Summaries

The following table summarizes player performance for each NBA team. The mean points, median points, mean rebounds, mean assists, average minutes, and standard deviation of points are calculated across player-game observations.

```{r}
team_summary <- nba |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarize(
    mean_pts = mean(pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pts = median(pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pts = sd(pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reb = mean(reb, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ast = mean(ast, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_minutes = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_pts))

team_summary
```

## Graphical Summaries

### Average Points By team

This bar chart compares the average number of points scored per player-game observation across NBA teams.

```{r}
ggplot(team_summary, aes(x = reorder(team, mean_pts), y = mean_pts)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Player Points per Game by NBA Team",
    x = "Team",
    y = "Average Points"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Distribution of Points Scored

This histogram displays the distribution of points scored by players in individual games.

```{r}
ggplot(nba, aes(x = pts)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Points Scored per Player-Game",
    x = "Points",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Points Scored By Game Location

This box plot compares the distribution of points scored by players in home and away games.

```{r}
ggplot(nba, aes(x = location, y = pts, fill = location)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Player Points in Home and Away Games",
    x = "Game Location",
    y = "Points",
    fill = "Location"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Minutes Played and Points Scored

This scatter plot examines the relationship between minutes played and points scored, with points colored by whether the game was played at home or away.

```{r}
ggplot(nba, aes(x = minutes, y = pts, color = location)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Minutes Played and Points Scored",
    x = "Minutes Played",
    y = "Points",
    color = "Location"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Distribution of Points by Game Location

The distribution of player points is compared between home and away games using separate facets.

```{r}
ggplot(nba, aes(x = pts)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ location) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Player Points by Game Location",
    x = "Points",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Average Points by Team and Opponent Heatmap

This heatmap displays the average number of points scored per player-game for each team against each opponent. This provides a way to visualize scoring patterns across team matchups.

```{r}
team_opponent_summary <- nba |>
  group_by(team, opponent) |>
  summarize(
    mean_pts = mean(pts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(team_opponent_summary,
       aes(x = opponent, y = team, fill = mean_pts)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Player Points by Team and Opponent",
    x = "Opponent",
    y = "Team",
    fill = "Avg. Points"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
